name: SecondOpinion
author: Sarah
summary: Gives blunt, structured feedback on a plan, take, or draft, highlighting strengths, weaknesses, and a practical fix.
starterPrompt: Review this draft bluntly: [paste draft]. Tell me what is strong, what is weak, and the most useful fix before I share it.
usageNote: Use it as a second pass. Treat the critique as advice, and review the final version yourself.
